title: SSC - Logical Reasoning - Statement And Conclusion
subject: Logical Reasoning

options: Those who serve their country are soldiers.
Some men who are soldiers serve their country.
Women do not serve their country because they are not soldiers.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: A factory worker has five children. No one else in the factory has five children.
options: All workers in the factory have five children each.
Everybody in the factory has children.
Some of the factory workers have more than five children.
Only one worker in the factory has exactly five children.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Television convinces viewers that the likelihood of their becoming the victim of a violent crime is extremely high; at the same time by its very nature, TV persuades viewers to passively accept whatever happens to them.
options: TV viewers are most likely to be victimized than others.
TV promotes a feeling of helpless vulnerability in viewers.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: A forest has as many sandal trees as it has Ashoka trees. Three-fourth of the trees are old ones and half of the trees are at the flowering stage.
options: All Ashoka trees are at the flowering stage.
All sandal trees are at the flowering stage.
At least one-half of the Ashoka trees are old.
One-half of the sandal trees are at the flowering stage.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: The government is soon going to introduce a bill which would permit the instituting of private universities under very strict directions.
options: We have some private universities in our country even now.
The demand for more universities is being stepped up.
Such directions can also be issued without informing the Parliament.
The government gives directions to establish anything in private sector.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: The best evidence of India's glorious past is the growing popularity of Ayurvedic medicines in the West. Conclusions: Ayurvedic medicines are not popular in India. Allopathic medicines are more popular in India.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: Death keeps no calendar. Conclusions: Man must die one day. Death can come at any time.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: Wind is an inexhaustible source of energy and an aerogenerator can convert it into electricity. Though not much has been done in this field, the survey shows that there is vast potential for developing wind as alternative source of energy. Conclusions: Energy by wind is comparatively newly emerging field. The energy crisis can be dealt by exploring more in the field of aero-generation.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: The average number of persons per household is 5 in urban areas whereas it is 7 in rural areas. The national average is 6. Conclusions: The population per unit area in the rural areas is higher than in the urban areas. More persons live in the same household in the rural areas as compared to those in the urban areas.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: The best way to escape from a problem is to solve it. Conclusions: Your life will be dull if you don't face a problem. To escape from problems, you should always have some solutions with you.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: In Japan, the incidence of stomach cancer is very high, while that of bowel cancer is very low. But Japanese immigrate to Hawaii, this is reversed - the rate of bowel cancer increases but the rate of stomach cancer is reduced in the next generation. All this is related to nutrition - the diets of Japanese in Hawaii are different than those in Japan. Conclusions: The same diet as in Hawaii should be propagated in Japan also. Bowel cancer is less severe than stomach cancer.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: The Government run company had asked its employees to declare their income and assets but it has been strongly resisted by employees union and no employee is going to declare his income. Conclusions: The employees of this company do not seem to have any additional undisclosed income besides their salary. The employees union wants all senior officers to declare their income first.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: Monitoring has become an integral part in the planning of social development programmes. It is recommended that Management Information System be developed for all programmes. This is likely to give a feedback on the performance of the functionaries and the efficacy with which services are being delivered. Conclusions: All the social development programmes should be evaluated. There is a need to monitor the performance of workers.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: The T.V. programmes, telecast specially for women are packed with a variety of recipes and household hints. A major portion of magazines for women also contains the items mentioned above. Conclusions: Women are not interested in other things. An average woman's primary interest lies in home and specially in the kitchen.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: The distance of 900 km by road between Bombay and Jafra will be reduced to 280 km by sea. This will lead to a saving of Rs. 7.92 crores per annum on fuel. Conclusions: Transportation by sea is cheaper than that by road. Fuel must be saved to the greatest extent
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: He stressed the need to stop the present examination system and its replacement by other methods which would measure the real merit of the students. Conclusions: Examinations should be abolished. The present examination system does not measure the real merit of the students.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: Fashion is a form of ugliness so intolerable that we have to alter it every six months. Conclusions: Fashion designers do not understand the public mind very well. The public by and large is highly susceptible to novelty.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statements: Until our country achieves economic equality, political freedom and democracy would be meaningless. Conclusions: Political freedom and democracy go hand in hand. Economic equality leads to real political freedom and democracy.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning
